mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 81 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies, though please note our air quality is at a moderate 54 today. The moon is currently in a new moon phase, and looking ahead, our overnight low will be 68 degrees with no rain predicted for the rest of the night.

City news is busy with road construction on Highway M starting August 18, which will involve utility work and lane shifts for about three weeks. Additionally, the City Plan Commission has meetings coming up on September 8 to review site plans for local developments like the Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park.

It is a big week for local fun with trivia happening today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by more trivia tomorrow at the Bogey Factory, The Mill, and Paddy Mac's, where you can also catch live music later this week.

In a notable incident from August 8, officers and a drone pilot assisted in the arrest of a burglary suspect who fled into a cornfield, and that same day, two juveniles were cited for underage alcohol consumption.
The delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, and you can pick it up at Culver's until they close tonight at 10 PM.
